_description: Runtime changes made after native-readiness-validation.json. That receipt stays as observed; each entry records why a frozen runtime file changed and its new LF SHA-256.

changes.reason: Azure SRE Agent sandbox now issues sidecar placeholder managed identity tokens (iss adc-msi-sidecar, claims tid/clientId/scp, no aud/appid) that the platform proxy swaps at egress. Token claim checks map them with normalize_sidecar_claims; cross_tenant_multitenant_fic can read the bridge app certificate from Key Vault (CROSS_TENANT_CERT_KEYVAULT_URL / CROSS_TENANT_CERT_NAME) because a sidecar token cannot be sent as a federated client assertion (AADSTS5002723).
changes.validated: Unit tests (tests/test_sidecar_tokens.py) and a live cross-tenant run in a lab agent on 2026-11-06 (4 files written; ARM 403 handled by Plane 2 as before).

changes.reason: Report presentation redesign only (report_template.html rebuilt into the standalone tool with build_tool.py): slim top bar with section navigation, export menu and print, verdict-first hero, KPI cards, layered dependency graph with legend, sortable and paged tables, A4 print footer and dark mode. Data collection, model, findings logic, parameters, output files and the tool-result JSON are unchanged.
changes.validated: Offline test suite (python -m pytest -q) and browser renders of the synthetic fixture at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 320 px plus A4 print (Edge headless).

changes.reason: Databricks costs module (report section 6, view=costs): read-only Cost Management queries (api-version 2025-03-01, AmortizedCost) for the workspace resource and its managed resource group grouped by the Databricks tags (Vendor, ClusterName, JobId, SqlEndpointId, DatabricksInstancePoolId) and up to three allocation tags; DBU vs infrastructure, attribution, the unattributed share, movers and optimisation signals with documented savings estimates counted once per object; runtime catalog reads (clusters/spark-versions, clusters/list-node-types); optional system.billing.usage detail through one fixed Statement Execution request, off by default; operation=self_test (built-in SIMULATED workspace, no network); validated presentation hooks for customer editions (REPORT_FOCUS, BRAND_THEME, BRAND_DISPLAY_FONT_DATA_URI, BRAND_LOGO_PLACEMENT); R06 evaluated from tag coverage. Parameter schema gains operation=self_test and view=costs; the skill and specialist instructions explain costs, estimates and when self_test may be used.
changes.validated: Offline test suite (python -m pytest -q, including tests/test_costs.py), Cost Management query shapes validated read-only against a lab subscription without Databricks (2026-11-12), Edge renders at 1440, 390 and A4 print plus dark mode, and a lab SRE Agent run of the customer edition built from this tool (self_test, four files HTTP 200).
